publisher: Ministry of Education, Religious Affairs and Sports, Greece
claim: Graduates of secondary schools in EU member states, with at least one parent not of Greek descent and the last two school years completed abroad, are a sub-category of the ministry's foreign-nationals route into Greek public universities. Enrolment requires Greek at B2, certified by the University of Athens, the University of Thessaloniki or the Centre for the Greek Language; a successful applicant without it may complete enrolment in the following year's enrolment period once they have it, or loses the place. 2026-2027 enrolment ran 11 to 25 September 2026.
excerpt: Β1. Οι Αλλοδαποί – Αλλογενείς υποψήφιοι, απόφοιτοι λυκείων ή αντίστοιχων σχολείων κρατών – μελών της Ευρωπαϊκής Ένωσης […] Προϋπόθεση για την εγγραφή των επιτυχόντων, εκτός των ανωτέρω, είναι η γνώση της ελληνικής γλώσσας. Αυτό αποδεικνύεται με Βεβαίωση επιπέδου Β2 […] ορίζεται προθεσμία εγγραφής […] από Παρασκευή 11 Σεπτεμβρίου έως και Παρασκευή 25 Σεπτεμβρίου 2026.
interpretation: This answers how a Danish IB graduate gets into a Greek-taught public programme: category B1, not the Panhellenic exams. The catch is Greek at B2, needed to enrol, not to apply. Addressed to universities, ΑΣΠΑΙΤΕ, ΑΣΤΕ and the higher ecclesiastical academies, which also shows which public institutions the route covers.
